sites.finding: Vermont Fish & Wildlife GIS feature OID 238/id 357 is named Otter Creek - Kwonumosk, in Weybridge, with Boating/Fishing access and steps. Its geometry is 44.086,-73.2472, about 2.1 miles from the former 44.0655,-73.2185 point. It supports a facility anchor, not a surveyed water edge. The sole previously public dependent route is held until route geometry and served catalog are rebuilt.
sites.requiredReopenEvidence: Regenerate and inspect canonical route geometry and catalog against the corrected state GIS point; verify current carry/parking and dam boundary.
